standard_prerequisites.name: The fppf-etale comparison diagram of topoi
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 7631-7632 and 7650-7652: the commutative diagram with h, a_{fppf}, h_{-1}, a used throughout the computation.

standard_prerequisites.name: Componentwise cohomological descent for QCoh modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 7635-7638 and 7667-7673: F_n = a_n^*F satisfies F_n = Rh_{n,*}h_n^*F_n, and the closing equality Rh_{-1,*}(h_{-1})^*F = F.

standard_prerequisites.name: Direct image on the total site is componentwise (modules)
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 7639-7640: a^*F = Rh_*h^*a^*F obtained by assembling the component identities.

standard_prerequisites.name: Simple descent for bounded modules along fppf hypercoverings
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 7655-7660: Ra_{fppf,*}a_{fppf}^* = id with La_{fppf}^* = a_{fppf}^* since a_{fppf} is flat (a_{fppf}^{-1}O_big = O_big,total, remark-augmentation-ringed).

core_obligations: Setup (proof lines 7631-7640): F_n = a_n^*F is the nth component of a^*F, a quasi-coherent O_{U_n}-module; componentwise cohomological descent gives F_n = Rh_{n,*}h_n^*F_n; assembling via the modules direct-image lemma yields a^*F = Rh_*h^*a^*F.

The four-equality chain (lines 7642-7660): Ra_*(a^*F) = Ra_*Rh_*h^*a^*F = Rh_{-1,*}Ra_{fppf,*}a_{fppf}^*(h_{-1})^*F = Rh_{-1,*}(h_{-1})^*F = F; the second equality by commutativity of the comparison diagram, the third by the bounded-modules simple descent (U is an fppf hypercovering of X in (Spaces/S)_fppf and La_{fppf}^* = a_{fppf}^* as a_{fppf} is flat, a_{fppf}^{-1}O_big = O_big,total), the last by the componentwise cohomological-descent lemma.
Conclusion (lines 7641-7643 and 7665-7666): the map F -> Ra_*(a^*F) is an isomorphism for every quasi-coherent O_X-module F.
proof_roadmap: Establish a^*F = Rh_*h^*a^*F from the componentwise cohomological descent.
Commute Ra_* through the comparison diagram and collapse Ra_{fppf,*}a_{fppf}^* by simple descent, using the flatness identification.
Conclude via the component cohomological-descent lemma.
difficulty_reason: Descent lemma (statement 7627-7639, proof 7641-7673): the derived (R-level) twin of the QCoh equivalence card L46172 - the four-equality chain Ra_*a^*F = F is justified equality by equality (diagram commutativity, simple descent for bounded modules with the flatness identification La_{fppf}^* = a_{fppf}^*, componentwise cohomological descent); no verification is omitted. H2: derived pushforward bookkeeping over the comparison diagram.
